title: Conjunction function tester
statement: For each natural number $n$, define a three-query nonadaptive tester for functions from sign strings of length $n$ to signs. Its seed is a pair of independent uniform sign strings $x,y\in\{-1,1\}^n$; it queries the function at $x$, at $y$, and at their coordinatewise conjunction, and accepts precisely when all three answers are present and the third is the conjunction of the first two.
